The coffee

Hot, or shaken over ice the Greek way.

A seasonal espresso blend, pulled to order. When it's cold, the flat white. When it isn't (or even when it is), the freddo espresso: a double shot shaken hard with ice until it froths.

Our story

Italian and Greek flavours on a Hackney Wick corner.

Wick House is a neighbourhood cafe for the walk to the Overground, the lunch break and the slow Saturday morning.

Behind the counter: focaccia and ciabatta filled to order, Greek favourites like souvlaki and spanakopita, and coffee pulled hot or shaken over ice.

Out front, you can't miss us. Look for the lilies on the green brick wall.
